TRUNCATE TABLE BUSC.DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE_DELTA;

WITH SRC AS
  (SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5', CONCAT(ACID, BANK_ID, TRAN_DATE_BAL, TRAN_DATE_TOT_TRAN, VALUE_DATE_BAL, VALUE_DATE_TOT_TRAN, END_EOD_DATE, LCHG_USER_ID, LCHG_TIME, RCRE_USER_ID, RCRE_TIME, TS_CNT, EAB_CRNCY_CODE, EOD_DATE)) AS HASHROW,
          ACID,
          BANK_ID,
          EOD_DATE,
          END_EOD_DATE
   FROM
     (SELECT [ACID],
             ISNULL(convert(datetime2, [EOD_DATE]), '1900-01-01T00:00:00.000') AS EOD_DATE,
             convert(numeric(25, 4), ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([TRAN_DATE_BAL], ' ', ''), ''), 0)) AS TRAN_DATE_BAL,
             convert(numeric(25, 4), ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([TRAN_DATE_TOT_TRAN], ' ', ''), ''), 0)) AS TRAN_DATE_TOT_TRAN,
             convert(numeric(25, 4), ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([VALUE_DATE_BAL], ' ', ''), ''), 0)) AS VALUE_DATE_BAL,
             convert(numeric(25, 4), ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([VALUE_DATE_TOT_TRAN], ' ', ''), ''), 0)) AS VALUE_DATE_TOT_TRAN,
             ISNULL(convert(datetime2, [END_EOD_DATE]), '1900-01-01T00:00:00.000') AS END_EOD_DATE,
             [LCHG_USER_ID],
             ISNULL(convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(LCHG_TIME, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')), '1900-01-01T00:00:00.000') AS [LCHG_TIME],
             [RCRE_USER_ID],
             ISNULL(convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(RCRE_TIME, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')), '1900-01-01T00:00:00.000') AS [RCRE_TIME],
             convert(numeric(5, 0), ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([TS_CNT], ' ', ''), ''), 0)) AS TS_CNT,
             [EAB_CRNCY_CODE],
             [BANK_ID],
             1 AS isActive,
             1 AS isLatest,
             left(FILE_NAME, 5) AS [BNK_CODE],
             substring(FILE_NAME, 7, 3) AS [SOURCE_CODE],
             [FILE_NAME],
             convert(datetime2, [insert_dttm]) AS insert_dttm
      FROM [D360].[STG_DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE]
      WHERE H = 'D' ) A),
     TGT AS
  (SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5', CONCAT(ACID, BANK_ID, TRAN_DATE_BAL, TRAN_DATE_TOT_TRAN, VALUE_DATE_BAL, VALUE_DATE_TOT_TRAN, END_EOD_DATE, LCHG_USER_ID, LCHG_TIME, RCRE_USER_ID, RCRE_TIME, TS_CNT, EAB_CRNCY_CODE, EOD_DATE)) AS HASHROW,
          ACID,
          BANK_ID,
          EOD_DATE
   FROM BUSC.DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE
   WHERE isLatest = 1 )
INSERT INTO BUSC.DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE_DELTA (SRC_HR, TGT_HR, ACID, BANK_ID, EOD_DATE, END_EOD_DATE, isActive, isLatest, RECORD_STATUS)
SELECT SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR,
       TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR,
       ISNULL(SRC.ACID, TGT.ACID) AS ACID,
       ISNULL(SRC.BANK_ID, TGT.BANK_ID) AS BANK_ID,
       ISNULL(SRC.EOD_DATE, TGT.EOD_DATE) AS EOD_DATE,
       SRC.END_EOD_DATE,
       CASE
           WHEN SRC.ACID IS NULL
                AND SRC.BANK_ID IS NULL
                AND SRC.EOD_DATE IS NULL THEN 0
           ELSE 1
       END AS isActive,
       CASE
           WHEN SRC.ACID IS NULL
                AND SRC.BANK_ID IS NULL
                AND SRC.EOD_DATE IS NULL THEN 0
           ELSE 1
       END AS isLatest,
       CASE
           WHEN SRC.ACID IN
                  (SELECT ACID
                   FROM D360.STG_DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER
                   WHERE DEL_FLG = 'Y') THEN 'DELETE'
           WHEN TGT.ACID IS NULL
                AND TGT.BANK_ID IS NULL
                AND TGT.EOD_DATE IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'
           ELSE 'UPDATE'
       END AS RECORD_STATUS
FROM SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TGT ON SRC.ACID = TGT.ACID
AND SRC.BANK_ID = TGT.BANK_ID
AND SRC.EOD_DATE = TGT.EOD_DATE
WHERE (TGT.ACID IS NULL
       OR TGT.BANK_ID IS NULL
       OR TGT.EOD_DATE IS NULL)
  OR SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW;

UPDATE TGT
SET END_EOD_DATE = ''
FROM BUSC.DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE TGT
WHERE END_EOD_DATE = '20991231';

UPDATE TGT
SET END_EOD_DATE = DELTA.END_EOD_DATE
FROM BUSC.DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE TGT
JOIN BUSC.DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.ACID = TGT.ACID
AND DELTA.BANK_ID = TGT.BANK_ID
AND DELTA.EOD_DATE = TGT.EOD_DATE
WHERE TGT.END_EOD_DATE = '';
